'''Ingo''' was a backwater [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]].

==History==
It had little organized government and was the second of 16 planets in its system. It had two frigid polar continents and two continents covered by arid, salt flats and craters. The planet had no indigenous sentient species and was colonized by a hundred different species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The inhabitants' existence was a constant struggle for survival due to Ingo's harsh climate forcing them to work hard to provide food and keep their equipment working.

Ingo was the location of the [[Tertiary Ingo Riots]].<ref name="Race for the Tessent">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> [[Vyn Narcassan]] secretly raised his daughters there.<ref name="Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> The gangster [[Tig Fromm]] maintained a secret base on Ingo where he developed the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ''[[Trigon One]]''. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], [[Zevel Hortine]] dumped [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on that planet, where they were later found by the colonists [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]].<ref name="P170" />

Years later, when C-3PO encountered the similar desert planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], his survival history analysis subroutine brought up memories of Ingo, and provided little useful information.<ref name="SWArchive-Visual Guide Chapter 6: Lost in the Desert, Image 2">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp06.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 6: Lost in the Desert}}</ref>
